capabilities: Lay out app screens on real device frames
Place blocks and items with anchors, snapping and measurement
Store one small JSON file per screen
Copy references and marks for a coding agent
Review agent changes with Keep or Undo and compare mocks
disambiguation: Not a book-design or publishing tool; it lays out app screens on device frames inside the vault.
extras: Ships a VELLUM.md agent guide written into the apps folder and re-written on updates; installable through BRAT as a beta plugin; makes no network requests of its own, only loading images given as https addresses.
intentEvidence: Claude artifacts and ChatGPT or Gemini canvas draw one too; Vellum is made for what comes after
motivation: The author wanted a mockup you can grab, keep and build from: change it by hand, keep it next to your code, and build it with your agent.
problem: Mockups made in a design app or an AI chat artifact cannot be hand-edited and read back by a coding agent, so the design and the code drift apart.

relations.evidence: Any agent that reads and writes files works (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)
Claude artifacts and ChatGPT or Gemini canvas draw one too; Vellum is made for what comes after

summary: Editor that lays out app screens on real device frames, keeping each screen as a small JSON file a coding agent can read, edit and build from.
